name: Asylum (Asielzoeker)

requirements.blocker_text: This can only be claimed while physically in the Netherlands or at a Dutch border.

This requires meeting one of two protection categories: refugee status (A status — personal persecution based on race, religion, nationality, political opinion, or membership of a social group) or subsidiary protection (B status — risk of serious harm, including from war or generalized violence).

evidence_required.document: Evidence supporting the persecution or serious-harm claim
Attendance at IND screening and asylum interview

outcome.duration_length: 3 years (reduced from 5 years by the reforms effective 12 June 2026), renewal subject to a country-safety re-examination

sources.title: Apply for asylum in the Netherlands - IND
IND news — EU Migration Pact and national asylum reform implementation

notes: MAJOR LIVE POLICY EVENT already in force, not pending: the EU Migration Pact plus two Dutch national laws — the Two-Status System Act (formalizing the A/B status distinction) and the Asylum Emergency Measures Act (Senate vote 21 April 2026) — took effect 12 June 2026. Confirmed changes per IND: (1) permanent asylum residence permits are NO LONGER ISSUED from that date (existing holders keep theirs); (2) new asylum permits are valid 3 years, cut from 5, with a mandatory country-safety re-examination before each renewal; (3) family reunification is now limited to the NUCLEAR family only (married partner and minor biological/adopted children under 18) — unmarried partners, adult children, and foster children are no longer eligible, and this applies RETROACTIVELY to over 19,000 applications submitted before 12 June that were still awaiting a decision at that date. This is the most significant confirmed-in-force policy change encoded in this dataset across all three countries so far — most other flagged risks (UK Earned Settlement, Germany's fast-track abolition) are either proposals or single-dimension changes; this one changes duration, renewal mechanics, and family rights simultaneously and retroactively. family_can_join marked true here reflects the NEW narrower nuclear-family-only definition, not the old broader one — a real accuracy correction versus how this route would have been encoded before 12 June 2026. duration_length is deliberately written as a full sentence rather than a bare number, since the reduction from 5 to 3 years and the new renewal mechanic are both load-bearing facts a flat number would lose.
